recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, flash-lit portrait of a woman with voluminous curly red hair dressed as a pageant queen, positioned in front of a glowing vanity mirror. The scene is saturated with kitsch elements like a rhinestone sash, a tiara, and a satin dress, all captured with a grainy, filmic texture that emphasizes a somber, theatrical mood.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm glowing vanity bulbs contrasting with cool teal fabric
Subject's pale, matte skin against dark, cluttered background
Sharp flash lighting creating hard shadows and specular highlights on sequins
Symmetry of the vanity mirror framing the central figure
coreInvariants: Heavy, theatrical blue eyeshadow and red lips
Triptych-style vanity mirror with exposed round bulbs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up, subject occupies the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct, melancholic gaze and the bright vanity bulbs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the diagonal sash, follows the curve of the hair, and circles back through the mirror reflections.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper corners and between the mirror panels provide breathing room for the bright central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and emerald green in the dress and background fabric.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and gold from the vanity lights and mirror frames.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant copper-red hair and saturated red lipstick.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primaries (red/blue) with high contrast between the bright bulbs and dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pastel or muted earth tones
Maintain high-key highlights and low-key shadows

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs composed entirely of individual sparkling rhinestones
High-density placement of gems within letter boundaries
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters must follow the curve and fold of the fabric sash

composition.overlap: sits on top of sash material

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: None; the rhinestone lettering acts as a singular graphic focal point.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy skeleton needed for rhinestone filling
Matches the physical prop aesthetic of a pageant sash

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a woman with red curly hair in a teal pageant dress, standing in front of a lit vanity mirror with a blank white sash.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom rhinestone-textured uppercase lettering onto the sash, following the diagonal orientation and fabric folds.

verificationChecks: Does the lettering look like physical gems?
Is the lighting consistent between the bulbs and the subject?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on makeup bottles
Exact text content on the sash

mustAchieve: Realistic light bloom from vanity bulbs
Tactile texture on the sequins and rhinestones

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sash text follows the perspective of the body
Check that the red hair has a frizzy, voluminous texture
Verify the mirror reflections show consistent background clutter
Confirm the flash creates a slight red-eye or harsh shadow effect
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject] in [Kitsch Costume] placed in a [Cluttered Theatrical Setting] lit by [Hard Flash and Warm Practical Lights] with [Rhinestone Typography] integrated into the scene.
